newsitem.title: UK: British unemployment falls 45,100 in December.
newsitem.headline: British unemployment falls 45,100 in December.

text.p: British unemployment fell 45,100 in December to 1.88 million to take the jobless rate down to 6.7 percent, official figures showed on Wednesday.
The fall was larger than analysts had expected.
The December unemployment total is the lowest for six years. The jobless total fell 95,400 in November to 6.9 percent of the workforce.

Chancellor the Exchequer (finance minister) Kenneth Clarke meets Eddie George, governor of the Bank of England, later on Wednesday to discuss monetary policy and a possible increase in interest rates from 6.0 percent.
Sterling rose half a pfenning to 2.6710 marks after the strong jobs data on a belief they increased the likelihood of a rate rise.
